speaker: john_heminges
text: Not one line of your own, Will. I counted. The old man speaks what was set, and then he is found.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He is found. I did not add a jest at the end of him. The yard had the twins for that.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: You stood like a man who has said his piece and is waiting to be believed. That is the part. I would have added a sigh. You were right not to.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A sigh is a line. He has enough. John, the book of the comedy is still at Field's. This afternoon was not that book.

speaker: john_heminges
text: This afternoon was Egeon, and the book of him was clean. Item, one father, recovered. Item, no word the galleries had not already paid for.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Today you missed none. I am for my dinner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Today was Egeon. I am going home. The jig is Thursday, and it is not mine.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Go. The gatherers can count without a father in the tiring-house.
